items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: And what was your father's name? Dave Williams Sr.

ctx.x: What's your full name? My full name? David Williams Jr. David Williams Jr. Dave A. Williams Jr. That's my full name. And what was your father's name? Dave Williams Sr. What's the A for? Albert. Oh, okay. Let's see, today's date is March the... What's today's date? March the... 20... 20... 28th. 1974. Okay. And we're at the Archive of New Honest Jazz, and we've been listening to these tapes. How did you happen to make this recording session with Poorey? Poorey? Yeah, that one we just prepared.

Oh, well, we were working. I had a little band at the time. Poorey was working with me, and those, some of the things that we did, were original, some of my things. Mm-hmm. Quick? Yeah. Oh, we happened to, you know, we got together, did those things. We had a little company, a little small company was named Eagle.
